answer: New identities need a sponsor whose atlas entry vouches for them, and every vertex in the trust graph costs real stake plus peer review. Each agent must stake collateral and solve a fresh proof-of-work tied to its registration epoch, recorded on a shared trellis of prior attestations. Launching N sybils thus requires N sponsors and N stakes, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0062's threat model.
